layers.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India (e-FRRO portal)
layers.process: The Tibetan Refugee Self Help Centre in Darjeeling and the Tashiling settlement at Sonada are Restricted Areas under the Fourth Schedule of India's Immigration and Foreigners Order 2025. Daytime visits are allowed without a permit if the settlement, monastery or institute gives the visitor's name, parentage, date of birth, nationality, passport and visa numbers to the Foreigners Registration Officer. Staying needs a Restricted Area Permit; foreign students can get one valid for 3 years if the institute vouches for them.

layers.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
layers.process: e-Visa holders can enter India at Bagdogra airport (Siliguri, the usual air gateway for Sikkim and Darjeeling) and at the Jaigaon land port opposite Phuentsholing, Bhutan (added 10 August 2026). The Sikkim tourism department runs a permit help desk at Bagdogra.
